policies: Positive evidence is the default: provider silence, a zero-result query, a missing page, or a false variant flag is unknown unless an exact exhaustive edge explicitly says otherwise.
Authority tier and card-existence capability never imply finish capability or absence capability.
A grading registry, collector registry, marketplace image, owner attestation, or inspected specimen may establish only the concrete positive record it identifies.
Every retained observation keeps its query URL and parameters, retrieval date, source record, and a generated SHA-256 content hash.
Unavailable, incomplete, rate-limited, and browser-blocked surfaces remain visible graph nodes; their failure state must not be converted into a negative verdict.
